meta.title: Online counselling in Malayalam & English
meta.description: Private online counselling and therapy in Malayalam and English, by video or audio, for Malayalis in Kerala and around the world.

common.comingSoon: This page is coming in a later phase.
common.notFoundBody: It may have moved, or the link may be out of date.

crisis.title: We are not a crisis service
crisis.body: If you or someone near you is in danger, or thinking about ending their life, please reach out right now. These lines are free and open all day and night.
crisis.abroad: Outside India? Please call your local emergency number.

footer.tagline: Counselling in Malayalam and English, from wherever you are.
footer.disclaimer: We offer counselling and psychotherapy. We do not diagnose, prescribe medication or provide emergency care.

hero.title: Talk to someone who understands, in the language you feel in.
hero.lead: Private sessions by video or audio, with counsellors who speak your language — wherever in the world you are.

mood.title: How are you feeling today?
mood.lead: Choose whatever feels closest. There's no wrong answer, and nothing you pick here is saved or shared.
mood.prompt: Pick one and we'll show you where you might begin.

services.title: Support for you, and the people around you

how.title: Four small steps, at your own pace
how.step1Body: Pick a service and a language. Malayalam, English, or a mix of both — whatever feels natural to you.
how.step2Body: Browse therapists yourself, or tell us a little and we'll suggest someone suited to you.
how.step3Body: Meet by video or audio from somewhere private. If you'd rather not be on camera, you don't have to be.
how.step4Body: Go at your own pace, and book follow-up sessions whenever you're ready.

therapists.title: People who listen, in your language
therapists.lead: Find someone whose experience, language and approach feel right for you.
therapists.credentialsNote: [Verified credentials — RCI registration, qualifications — will appear on every profile.]

breath.title: Take a breath with us
breath.lead: Breathe in as the circle grows, and slowly out as it softens. Four seconds in, six seconds out.
breath.still: In for four, out for six.

testimonials.title: What people tell us
testimonials.note: These are placeholders. Real testimonials will appear only with written consent.

business.title: Wellbeing programmes for workplaces and campuses
business.lead: Confidential counselling for your people, plus workshops in Malayalam and English, shaped around your team or students.
business.workBody: Employee counselling, manager training and workshops on stress and burnout.
business.campusBody: Student counselling, sessions on exam stress, and support for teaching staff.
business.cta: Talk to us about a programme

cta.title: Whenever you're ready, we're here.
cta.lead: Your first step can be a small one. Book a session, or just look around for now.
cta.whatsapp: Prefer to message? Reach us on WhatsApp
cta.someone: Booking for someone you care about? You can book on their behalf, with their agreement.

styleguide.title: Design system
styleguide.intro: Every colour, type size and component used across the site. This page is for the team and is hidden from search engines.
styleguide.malayalamNote: Chillu letters and conjuncts should join cleanly in headings, buttons and chips.
styleguide.sample: Calm, grounded and human. A space to breathe before you begin.
styleguide.cardBody: One-to-one sessions at your pace, about whatever is on your mind.
styleguide.fieldNameError: Please enter a name, so we know what to call you.
styleguide.marqueeItem: [Placeholder testimonial — awaiting a real, consented quote]

servicesPage.metaDescription: Individual, couples, teen and family therapy online, in Malayalam and English.
servicesPage.title: Find the kind of support that fits
servicesPage.lead: Every session is online, private, and in the language you're most comfortable in.
servicesPage.teens1: A parent or guardian gives consent when booking.
servicesPage.teens2: In the first session, the therapist agrees with you both what stays private and what may be shared.
servicesPage.teens3: If there's a serious safety concern, guardians will be told. This is explained at the very start.
servicesPage.every2Body: Stay off camera if you prefer.
servicesPage.every3Body: Confidential, from anywhere you feel safe.
servicesPage.notSureBody: Start with an individual session. If couples or family sessions would help, your therapist can suggest them later.

concernsPage.metaDescription: Plain-language guides to anxiety, depression, relationships, burnout and more, and how therapy can help.
concernsPage.title: What's on your mind?
concernsPage.lead: Short, plain-language guides to common struggles. Read at your own pace. You don't need a label before you reach out.
concernsPage.notListed: Don't see what you're going through?
concernsPage.notListedBody: That's okay. Therapists can support you with many other concerns too. Book a session and explain in your own words.
concernsPage.signsNote: Everyone's experience is different. This isn't a checklist for diagnosis.
concernsPage.ctaBody: You don't need to have it all figured out. A first session is simply a place to start.
concernsPage.scaffoldNote: [Full guide still to be written. This page uses the standard template until then.]
concernsPage.genericHelp: A therapist offers a private, non-judgemental space to talk about what you're going through, understand it better, and find practical ways forward, at your own pace.

therapistsPage.metaDescription: Browse counsellors and therapists who speak Malayalam and English. Filter by language, concern, session type and availability.
therapistsPage.title: Find someone you feel at ease with
therapistsPage.lead: Use the filters, or let us suggest someone. Nothing you choose here is saved or added to the web address.
therapistsPage.placeholderNote: [These are placeholder profiles. Real therapists will be added before launch.]
therapistsPage.empty: No one matches all of these yet. Try removing a filter, or let us match you.
therapistsPage.credentialsBody: [Degrees, RCI registration number and professional memberships, to be supplied and verified.]
